subject: [PATCH 42/60] mm: fail private placement on exhaustion instead of OOM killing

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series addresses private memory allocation failures by failing the allocation instead of invoking the OOM killer, which has no good answer for private memory exhaustion. The approach taken involves modifying the kernel's memory management to handle private memory as a fixed pool.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses private memory allocation failures by failing the allocation instead of invoking the OOM killer, which has no good answer for private memory exhaustion. The approach taken involves modifying the kernel's memory management to handle private memory as a fixed pool, similar to the HugeTLB pool.
